This document outlines the 
major maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed every five years as indicated by Y5 
in the title block.

The intermediate pressure turbine (1MAB) is a double flow 2. turbine 
 with 17 reaction stage per flow incl. 3 twisted stages

The steam turbine converts the thermal energy of the steam 
generated by the boiler into mechanical on the shaft.

The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Rhman Nassar, tested at 
13 Mar 2003, reviewed by maintenance manager eng. Ahmed Abdel Rahman, tested by 
eng. Sameh Ibrahem kamall, revised 
by EDEPC inspection and quality 
control general director 
eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil, and approved by eng. head 
sector Tarek Yousef of Ayon Mousa 
Power Station.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman: 
 EDEPC planning & financial prediction head sector, and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.

Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves
 etc.

items:
A work permit must be issued and maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves
 etc.
Shut down the unit.

Operating personnel must 
 be notified before starting and maintenance, inspection or repair work.

Before starting work on 
 the steam turbine ensure that steam turbine has come to a complete stand still 
 and secured against start up.

Shat down systems 
 (pneumatic, hydraulic, etc.) and depressurize relevant sections.

Operate turning gear till 
 T = 100 ºc then Open systems carefully.

Steam turbine components 
 may remain hot even after coast down and cause burns. Allow sufficient time 
 for components to cool down.
Complete maintenance tool set.

Cleaning fluid,
 Rag

Manual puller,
 Feeler gauge

Dial indicator,
 Vibrometer

Measure absolute and 
 relative vibrations level for bearings by the measurement devices set on 
 bearing and compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine 
 what to do.

Measure absolute and 
 relative expansion value for shaft and casing by the measurement devices set 
 on bearing and casing and compare it with the setting value.

Check temperature 
 difference between upper and lower casing halves by temperature sensors set on 
 the upper and lower casing halves.

Check bearing 
 temperature by the thermocouple set on bearing and compare it with the setting 
 value.

Check bearing oil 
 temperature by the thermocouple set on the entrance and exit of bearing oil 
 and compare it with the setting value.

Check the upper margin 
 and the lower margin for casing.

Check seal strips and 
 flanges for leakage.

Disassemble bearings, 
 check bearing seats in bearing housing.

Inspect bearing guides 
 for wear and bindings by X-rays.

Check bearing 
 surfaces, babbit bonding and bearing clearance which is listed down in the 
 MRDS.

Check seal rings and 
 replace seal rings if it is required.

Check condition and 
 performance of shaft lift oil system, by checking the exit of lifting oil from 
 the lower half of bearing, check for crack of the nozzle by ultrasonic waves 
 or X-rays.

Check condition and 
 performance of temperature monitoring system by putting the thermocouple in 
 oil or water and heating the fluid to the alarm and trip temperature and 
 observe the thermocouple temperature from DCS

Check bearing pedestal 
 anchor preloads.

Open handholes of HP 
 casing, perform boroskop inspection for blades.

Check bolts fixation, 
 then re-tightens it (if it is needed).

Discharge the oil from 
 the main tank and clean it.

Check the validity of 
 oil and add or change it (if it is needed).
